ui_bugs.issue: `m.type.toUpperCase()` crashes the entire Communication Builder page with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading toUpperCase)' when a milestone record is missing the `type` field. This happens for ANY legacy or user-made milestone that lacks `type` (e.g. older client payloads, migrated records). Needs a guard like `(m.type || 'success').toUpperCase()` or compute `tagLabel` only when `m.type` is a string.

action_items: HIGH: Add a null-safety guard in BiffTab.jsx line 350 so a milestone missing `type` doesn't crash the Communication Builder page. Example: `const tagLabel = isAdvocate ? 'ADVOCATE' : String(m.type || 'success').toUpperCase();` and fall back to a neutral tag style when type is missing.
critical_code_review_comments: portal_routes.without_samples() uses `all(e.get(k) == v for k,v in s.items())` — this correctly keeps parent-made entries with the same title but different id/date/note (verified live). Good match-ALL semantics.
portal_ai.refine_biff() status 'unavailable' after one retry when missing facts remain is covered by 9 unit tests; live test confirms 'ok' path preserves numbers/day-words/questions.

BiffTab.jsx BiffMilestones does not defensively handle milestones without `type` — this is the single HIGH-priority defect found this iteration. The Communication Builder page re-uses the same component via CommunicationBuilderView, so one bad legacy row brings the whole page down (not just a list row).

biff-refine endpoint body model is `raw` + `safety_flagged`; the spec in the review request wrote `raw_text`/`flags:{safety_flagged}` which doesn't match — recommend keeping the backend contract as-is (it's correct) but the review-request wording should be updated for future testers.
seed_data_creation: Cleared parent1 portal_state milestones[]/biff_logs[] via direct Mongo update after an initial sample-purge test wrote type-less rows (which triggered the BiffMilestones crash and became useful for RCA). parent1's milestones and biff_logs are now empty — safe starting point.
context_for_next_testing_agent: biff-refine body is {raw, safety_flagged} (NOT raw_text/flags). After each PUT /api/portal/state test, verify the GET response has `{exists, state:{...}}` envelope. parent1 portal_state currently has milestones=[] and biff_logs=[] (reset at end of iter137). The Welcome landing shows legal-ack modal on first dashboard load each session even when context changes; accept it before clicking door-comm. The runtime crash reported here surfaces as a red overlay 'Uncaught runtime errors: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading toUpperCase)' from BiffMilestones — reproducible by inserting any milestone without `type` into portal_state and reloading /dashboard→door-comm.
rca of the issue: BiffTab.jsx line 350 computes `m.type.toUpperCase()` with no fallback. When portal_state.milestones contains a record without `type` (e.g. older client payload, PUT body that omitted the field, or test fixtures), React throws 'Cannot read properties of undefined' during Array.map, caught by the dev error overlay. Because CommunicationBuilderView embeds <BiffMilestones ...>, the crash blocks the entire Communication Builder page, not just one row. Mitigation: coerce `m.type` to a string with a sane default before `.toUpperCase()`, and fall back to a neutral tag class when `type` is unknown.
